description: The provided file is a Kotlin class defining a 'HomeFragment' for an Android TV application using the Leanback library. It constructs a home screen UI with multiple rows such as hero metrics, daily workouts, recommended workouts, progress charts, badges, and profile shortcuts. The class manages UI setup, data binding from a mock repository, event handling for clicks, and dynamic row building.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main UI fragment for the home screen of an Android TV app, managing multiple content rows, user interactions, and navigation to discovery, profile, and search features.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up UI, builds content rows, and event listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes rows upon resuming to reflect latest data.

methods.name: setupUi
methods.description: Configures UI elements such as title, colors, headers, and search button.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Constructs and populates the content rows for hero metrics, workouts, progress, badges, and profile shortcuts.

methods.name: refreshRows
methods.description: Rebuilds the row content to update displayed data.

methods.name: setupEventListeners
methods.description: Assigns click listeners for user interactions on items.

methods.name: StringPresenter
methods.description: Defines a presenter for short string items acting as shortcuts.
